title: Jellycat bunny's bitten nose rebuilt with fur from his own foot
description: A dog bit the nose off this much-loved Jellycat bunny. New fabric could not match his faded colour, so fur from his own foot was transplanted to rebuild his face. After a deep clean, fresh stuffing and a new pink nose, he is soft and whole again.
itemDetails: This soft toy carries the woven Jellycat London label, with its cat logo, and a care label marked Made in China. Jellycat is a British soft toy company launched in London in 1999. His long floppy ears, rounded body, pink nose and small dark eyes follow the style of Jellycat's Bashful Bunny range, which is made in several sizes and colours. The range is known for its soft looped plush and its relaxed, sitting shape.
repairDetails: This bunny arrived after a dog bit his nose right off. The bite tore through the fur and backing fabric, leaving the stuffing exposed, and years of cuddles had left him flat and matted. All of the old stuffing was removed so he could have a deep clean. Once he was dry, the full damage was easier to see. The torn edges around his face were unpicked, and his original eyes were carefully removed so they could be reused. New plush fabric was tested first, but it could not match the colour his fur had faded to over the years. The best match was already on him, so a piece of fabric was taken from his foot and transplanted to the nose area. His feet are now a little smaller, but his face has the same fabric as the rest of him. Iron-on backing reinforced the worn head before the transplanted fabric was stitched in by hand. A separate new pink nose was made and sewn on, using a similar Jellycat bunny as a reference. His original eyes went back in, fresh stuffing restored his shape, and the remaining seams were closed by hand.
